title: MrCall model table, schema 1: the decision record
description: Per preset its output-price ceiling and per role two rankings of at most five catalogue models: `ranking` over every vendor, `anthropic_ranking` over the Anthropic subset (run on a personal Anthropic key). No price, score or request metadata: those are the snapshot's, so a refresh of prices moves no record. `version` is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the document without `version` (contract/README.md). Static gates beyond this schema: zylch/llm/roles/gates.py:check_table.

schema.description: The contract version of this document.

catalogue_read_at.description: When the OpenRouter catalogue it resolved was read (UTC).

requirements_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bytes of the engine's roles/requirements.json it resolved.

measured_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bytes of the roles/measured.json whose results and thresholds it ranked by.

price.description: USD per million tokens as a canonical decimal string: no sign, exponent, leading zero or trailing fractional zero.

ceiling.description: The highest catalogue output price (USD per million tokens) a ranked model may have.

roles.description: Keyed by role name, as requirements.json declares the roster.

ranking.description: Best first; the first entry is the pick.

anthropic_ranking.description: The same rule over the anthropic/* subset; may be empty.

direct_id.description: Anthropic's own id when the snapshot prices the model on the direct transport, else null.
